text:
sasha: heads-up, onboarding az13b-large weights into staging. weights are at s3://redwood-models/az13b/v2/weights.safetensors. smoke tests show tokenizer duplicating BOS and inserting extra spaces. also hitting a runtime failure when starting triton container locally (CUDA/kernel mismatch). anyone free for quick async triage?

matt: can you paste the failing log and a sample tokenized output?

sasha: sample tokenization output: `['<bos>', '<bos>', 'Hello', ',', 'world', '!']` — expected single <bos>. here's the triton crash snippet: 
```
E TritonServer: failed to load model az13b: /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcublas.so.11: undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmul
KernelSelector: no matching kernel for (cuda 11.7, arch 7.5) -> falling back to generic
```

liam: that duplicated BOS smells like mismatched tokenizer config or double-add in preprocessing. which tokenizer package/version? sometimes tokenizers 0.14 -> 0.15 changed default add_special_tokens behavior. run `pip show tokenizers transformers` in the container.

anya: also check tokenizer_config.json and special_tokens_map.json in the model repo. If pad/bos settings are present both there and in our preprocessing wrapper we can add BOS twice.

sasha: `pip show tokenizers` inside the failing image shows 0.10.3 (yikes). our exporter used a newer HF tokenizer before saving. so mismatch likely.

matt: ok two things to fix: 1) pin tokenizer version or ship tokenizer.json with the model, 2) update preprocessing to be idempotent (i.e., don't add bos if already present). For quick test, try `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({})` vs `tokenizer.add_bos_token=False` in code.

liam: quick patch suggestion for preprocessing (in the repo): 
```python
# avoid adding BOS twice
if tokens and tokens[0] != tokenizer.bos_token_id:
    tokens = [tokenizer.bos_token_id] + tokens
```

infra-bot: kernel selection note: our runtime printed `compiled_kernels: [8.0, 8.6]` and the node is `compute=7.5` so the runtime fell back. That explains perf regressions but not the cublas symbol error.

triton-bot: container base image used for this build: `nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:23.08-py3` on top of `nvidia/cuda:11.7-runtime-ubuntu20.04`. Triton 23.08 expects libcublasLt symbols from CUDA >=11.8 in some builds.

anya: if Triton binary was built against 11.8+ but runtime image is 11.7 you'll see undefined symbol. two options: upgrade base CUDA runtime to 11.8/12.1 or rebuild Triton with matching CUDA.

sasha: thoughts on fastest path? we need staging serving up in <24h.

matt: fastest is rebuild image using `nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime-ubuntu22.04` and pull matching triton tag if available. If you prefer not to rebuild Triton, use the triton container variant that bundles CUDA libs. But our infra images usually prefer system CUDA for drivers.

liam: also verify cuBLASLt presence: `readelf -Ws /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcublasLt.so | grep cublasLtMatmul` inside image. If missing, upgrade CUDA runtime.

sasha: trying a local rebuild now. build command I'm using: 
```bash
make triton-image CUDA_BASE_IMAGE=nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime-ubuntu22.04 TRITON_VERSION=23.08
```

matt: while that's building, for the tokenizer quickfix you can add a small migration script to the model repo that writes a canonical tokenizer.json (tokenizer.save_pretrained) and sets `tokenizer_config.json: {"add_bos_token": false}` so older tokenizers behave. Put it in `models/az13b/v2/` and the loader will prefer it.

anya: also run config validation: `python tools/validate_model_config.py models/az13b/v2/model-config.yaml` — the validator checks special_tokens, pad_token_id, max_length and will flag double definitions.

infra-bot: build started on runner ci-04. ETA ~12m.

triton-bot: FYI, we had to add a fallback patch earlier for kernels: if compute capability not present, runtime loads `generic_matmul` with severe perf hit. Consider adding 7.5 to compiled_kernels list on next compile to avoid fallback on older nodes.

sasha: build finished locally and image starts in staging. Ran smoke -> tokenizer output fixed after shipping tokenizer.json + migration script. Perf looks acceptable with new CUDA runtime.

matt: can you paste the final smoke token list and confirm there's only one BOS now?

sasha: final tokens: `['<bos>', 'Hello', ',', 'world', '!']` :white_check_mark: staging endpoint warmed, generation latency ~330ms (vs 1.1s before kernel fallback).

liam: great. followups: 1) add tokenizer migration script as PR, 2) add CI check to verify tokenizers version and tokenizer.json presence, 3) schedule a short windows to rebuild runtime images with compiled kernels for 7.5 if we still host older GPUs.

anya: i'll open a task in eng-runtime backlog and tag infra for image upgrade rollout.

sasha: thanks all — will open PRs and link infra ticket. tagging @matt for review on the migration script. :rocket:
